title: External SEO Ranking Snapshot Request
description: Input contract for the external-seo ranking fetch node. Describes the request shape an SEO/Analytics provider receives: the campaign keywords plus the target search engine and locale. Replaces the W0-A7 data-only placeholder with a concrete, content-addressed schema document.

keywords.description: Campaign keywords to fetch rankings for.

trackedDomain.description: Optional owned domain whose positions are reported separately.
